selection_rule: Development families are the five families already consumed by the first V16 block-disjoint diagnostic. Final-validation families are chosen only from the remaining never-scored families using pre-model support counts, before any V17 model evaluation. Do not tune on final_validation_families.
important_limit: X-IIoTID contains almost no clean-history future-positive onset windows for these final families. This frozen family test can validate unseen-family generalization, not verified pre-attack onset lead time. A separate timestamped ground-truth dataset is required for the pre-compromise forecasting claim.
